title: Refuse to verify a claim with no source
narrative: Fangore receives an atomic claim with no usable source attached. He runs the citation check and verifies the product keeps the claim unverified — there is nothing for the model to endorse. Builds on the happy path in `fangore_jev_citation_matching_claim`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded support choice (`supported` / `contradicted` / `insufficient` / `unavailable`). Host policy sets `claim_verified` only when the final action is `supported` and the path does not escalate.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/missing_source.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
